findings.description: In the foreground view, the toothbrush vanishes from the man's right hand as his fingers curl near his chin (while remaining visible in the mirror reflection), before reappearing at 00:02 as he lifts his hand.

As the man brings the toothbrush up to his head, it morphs into a dark comb/brush used to stroke his hair, then morphs back into the white-and-blue toothbrush at 00:04 as he lowers his hand back toward his face.
